TEXT.English: The aircraft rebases to the nearest carrier with room for it and sleeps on board (with Fighters on Carriers Intercept, it intercepts). A rebase has no range limit, so it gets there in one move. A selected group fills the nearest carriers first. If no carrier has room, it waits until one has.
